description: This file defines the RequestResetPasswordController class responsible for handling password reset requests within the authentication module of the OrangeHRM system. It manages CSRF token validation, searches for user records, logs password reset requests, and redirects users accordingly.

classes.name: RequestResetPasswordController
classes.description: Controller handling password reset requests, managing CSRF validation, user lookup, and redirect responses.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ResetPasswordService instance used for user lookup and logging password reset requests.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the password reset request, validates CSRF token, searches for the user, logs the request, and determines the redirect URL based on success or failure.
